cards.say: one hundred and fifty six divided by twelve. thirteen. Because twelve times thirteen equals one hundred and fifty six.
ninety one divided by seven. thirteen. Because seven times thirteen equals ninety one.
one hundred and forty four divided by nine. sixteen. Because nine times sixteen equals one hundred and forty four.
two hundred and twenty five divided by fifteen. fifteen. Because fifteen times fifteen equals two hundred and twenty five.
one thousand divided by eight. one hundred and twenty five. Because eight times one hundred and twenty five equals one thousand.
six hundred divided by twenty five. twenty four. Because twenty five times twenty four equals six hundred.

cards.back: Multiplication. Use it to check: if 72 ÷ 8 = 9, then 9 × 8 = 72.
cards.say: Division is the inverse of... Multiplication. Use it to check: if seventy two divided by eight equals nine, then nine times eight equals seventy two.
fifty divided by seven. seven remainder one. seven times seven equals forty nine, leaving one.
one hundred divided by eight. twelve remainder four. eight times twelve equals ninety six, leaving four.

cards.front: 100 ÷ 3 with the remainder as a fraction
cards.say: One hundred divided by three with the remainder as a fraction. Thirty three and one third. Three times thirty three equals ninety nine, leaving one out of three.
twenty nine divided by four as a decimal. seven point two five. four times seven equals twenty eight, leaving one, and one divided by four equals zero point two five.
Seven divided by two as a decimal. Three point five.
One divided by four as a decimal. Zero point two five.
Three divided by five as a decimal. Zero point six.
One divided by eight as a decimal. Zero point one two five.
nine divided by twenty as a decimal. zero point four five. nine divided by twenty equals forty five divided by one hundred.

cards.back: 0.2. Six tenths shared into 3 gives 2 tenths.
cards.say: zero point six divided by three. zero point two. Six tenths shared into three gives two tenths.
Four point eight divided by six. Zero point eight. Forty eight divided by six equals eight, so forty eight tenths divided by six is eight tenths, which is zero point eight.
Two point four divided by four. Zero point six.

cards.back: 24. How many halves are in 12? Two in every whole one, so 24.
cards.say: twelve divided by zero point five. twenty four. How many halves are in twelve? Two in every whole one, so twenty four.

cards.front: 50 children travel in cars that hold 4 each. How many cars are needed?
cards.back: 13 cars. 50 ÷ 4 = 12 remainder 2, and the 2 extra children need another car, so round up.
cards.say: fifty children travel in cars that hold four each. How many cars are needed? thirteen cars. fifty divided by four equals twelve remainder two, and the two extra children need another car, so round up.

cards.front: You can fill boxes of 6 pens from 50 pens. How many full boxes?
cards.back: 8 full boxes. 50 ÷ 6 = 8 remainder 2, and the remainder is not enough for another full box, so round down.
cards.say: You fill boxes of six pens from fifty pens. How many full boxes? Eight. Fifty divided by six equals eight remainder two, which is not enough for another full box, so round down.
